'''2013 Worlds Day 3 Kevin Shannon DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
